Rooms.Name: Entrance to Ultima
Rooms.Description:
The blue moongate casts a strange blue light upon a huge gate to the
south. The gate is open and beyond it you see a simple village. Around the
gate there are two pedestals. On the first pedestal, there is a magic
scroll. On the second there is a plaque.

Exits.Description: There is a huge gate

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
An image flies out of the scroll and creates a huge image of a face
approximately ten feet off the ground.  It says, "Welcome to Ultima,
where adventure and excitement may be found for all people, and all
levels.  Each of the planes increase in level. Have a nice day!"

The plaque reads, "The Ultima Area was made for Merc 2.0 and converted
to Elite 5.1,"

Rooms.Name: New Magincia Road
Rooms.Description:
This is the main road of New Magincia. The dirt path continues to
the south and a huge gate lies to the north.

Exits.Description: There is a huge gate.

Rooms.Name: New Magincia Road
Rooms.Description:
The path continues to the south and the north. You see the tracks
of sheep here.

Exits.Description: The path continues to the north.
There is a shimmering light to the south.

Rooms.Name: The New Magincia Moongate
Rooms.Description:
You see another moongate here, exactly between the crossing of
two paths.

Rooms.Name: New Magincia Road
Rooms.Description:
The path continues to the south and north. On the east there seems
to be administrative building.

Exits.Description: There is a shimmering light.

Rooms.Name: New Magincia Road
Rooms.Description:
The dirt road path ends here in a grove. You can continue back to
the north, and there is an old abandoned house to the west.

Rooms.Name: Stables
Rooms.Description:
This is the stables for the shepherd. There are many fine horses here.
You can return to the barn to the south.

Exits.Description: The front part of the barn is to the south.

Rooms.Name: Barn
Rooms.Description: This is your basic barn, with hay and stables to the north.

Exits.Description: You hear neighing, intermixed with a strange talking.

Rooms.Name: Humility Lane
Rooms.Description:
This is an even smaller dirt path that crosses New Maginica Road.
To your north there is a barn, and to the south you see a condemned
building, though you cannot enter this way. The west is blocked off
by a herd of sheep.

Exits.Description: There is a shimmering light to the east.

Rooms.Name: Condemned House
Rooms.Description:
This place is wrecked, the rafters have fallen, and light shines
through a large hole in the roof. You wonder what kinds of animals
have taken up residence here.

Rooms.Name: Condemned House
Rooms.Description:
As you walk into the house, you realize that this house must not
have been reconstructed yet from the ruin of Old Magincia. Faint
intimations of foolish pride can still be seen through the wreckage.

Rooms.Name: Attic
Rooms.Description: The attic is dark, and you smell some vestiges of bat guano.

Exits.Description: The rest of the house is down.

Rooms.Name: House
Rooms.Description:
This is a small humble house. You do not see much here, though there
is some faint squeaking.

Exits.Description: You see the faint outline of a trapdoor.

Rooms.Name: Humility Lane
Rooms.Description:
This is a very small path. It ends here with a fence to the east. To
the west is the Moongate, and to the north there is a small house.

Rooms.Name: Entrance to the Office
Rooms.Description:
Though this room is small, it acts as a meeting place for Katrina
and any other person that she has to meet. You can exit to the west
or enter an office to the south.

Rooms.Name: Katrina's Office
Rooms.Description:
This office is very sparse... and humble. There are no decorations,
in fact the room is bare except for a simple desk and its chair.

Rooms.Name: Library
Rooms.Description:
This is an amazingly HUGE library. Its musty smell and the collapsed
bookshelf to your north tell you that it also must be ancient. In any
case you can't get out of the Library so just pick a book and start
reading. The stacks continue to the east and west.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
These shelves deal with the fascinating letter A.  Among the more
interesting books are, "Andersen's tips on Area Building."  "The
Art of Spamming" and "Axes and You."

Rooms.Name: Library
Rooms.Description: The Library continues here, with exits to the east and west.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
These books are about the letters B and C.  Some titles are: 'Boom
Boxes: How large will they become?' and 'Cutlery: The fine points
of Killing' and of course the classic, 'Casret's Titles.'

Rooms.Name: Library
Rooms.Description: The Library continues here, with exits to the east and west.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This shelf has books dealing with the 'D's'.  'Dracula, Blood Sucker
or Beavis fan?' seems to be the most interesting book here.

Rooms.Name: Library
Rooms.Description: The Library continues here, with exits to the east and south.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The 'E' section is here.  One book, "Howard Stern" doesn't seem to
belong here.

Rooms.Name: Library
Rooms.Description: The Library continues here, with exits to the north and west.

Exits.Description: You see a big desk and a man.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
You find 'Fax Fun' and 'Farts: How to Blame it on the Dog.' in this
section of the library.

Rooms.Name: Library Office
Rooms.Description:
A big desk dominates this room. All books must go through this
office before getting taken out.

Rooms.Name: Library
Rooms.Description: The Library continues here, with exits to the west and east.

Exits.Description: You see a huge desk.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The books here start with 'G'.  'Grating Cheese with Julia Childs' and
'Garamond: What kind of font is this anyway?' lie here.

Rooms.Name: Library
Rooms.Description: The Library continues here, with exits to the east and south .

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The books here comprise 'H' and 'I'.  'Hiya: The Women who Use it, and
the Man who Uses the Women' and 'Icaza Loves Ya' are here in gaudy and
annoying covers.

Rooms.Name: Library
Rooms.Description: The Library continues here, with exits to the north and east.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
These books start with the letter 'J'.  'Jokey Smurf's Greatest
Explosions' and 'The Judge take on New York' seem to be the most
popular books.

Rooms.Name: Library
Rooms.Description: The Library continues here, with exits to the west and east.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: Hmmm this is the 'K' section, and 'Kicking Vs. Bashing' is here.

Rooms.Name: Library
Rooms.Description: The Library continues here, with exits to the west and east.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: A book titled, 'Lick me, Lick you'  is here.

Rooms.Name: Library
Rooms.Description: The Library continues here, with exits to the west and south.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
'Mahatma Teaches French' and 'MC Echser: The Rap Star and Paradoxical
Artist'.

Rooms.Name: The Library Moongate
Rooms.Description: A blue moongate is here, lighting up the otherwise featureless room.

Rooms.Name: Library
Rooms.Description: The Library continues here, with exits to the north and west.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: Hmmm... This is the 'N' section... but 'Nothing' seems to be here.

Rooms.Name: Library
Rooms.Description: The Library continues here, with exits to the east and west.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This is the 'OP' section.  You hear moaning behind those stacks, yup
there on the floor is another P.

Rooms.Name: Library
Rooms.Description: The Library continues here, with exits to the east and west.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
'Quai Mackdaddy Monk and 'Rhinoplasty, or The Inebriation of Wild
Animals' are here.

Rooms.Name: Library
Rooms.Description: The Library continues here, with exits to the east and west..

Exits.Description: Hinges on a shelf?

ExtraDescriptions.Description: 'Secret Door: The Shelf' is on the shelf.

Rooms.Name: Library
Rooms.Description: The Library continues here, with exits to the east and north.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: 'Textile Farming' and 'Tempting Miss Daisy' is here.

Rooms.Name: Library
Rooms.Description: The Library continues here, with exits to the south and north.

Exits.Description: There is an odd chattering to the north.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: 'Ultima: The Building of an Area' is here.

Rooms.Name: Web
Rooms.Description:
There is a Huge Web here, stretching from shelf to shelf... and
stupid you wandered into it.

Rooms.Name: Library
Rooms.Description: The Library continues here, with exits to the south and east.

Exits.Description: There is a strange chattering noise to the south.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: "Yaz: Grooming Tips" is here.

Rooms.Name: The Center of the Tavern
Rooms.Description:
The moongate has opened inside a huge party. There are bards and
other townsmen. This must be Britain. There are people everywhere
carrying their drinks and singing everywhere. The party continues to
the north, east, south, and west.

Rooms.Name: The Northwest Corner of the Tavern
Rooms.Description:
This is where the tavern entrance would be if it wasn't packed with
humans trying to get in or get out. There is no chance of you leaving
the tavern tonight. You leave east or the south.

Rooms.Name: The North Wall of the Tavern
Rooms.Description:
Party-goers mingle here in front of the bar. They seem to be having
a great time and wish for you to join them. You can continue on to the
south, east or north.

Rooms.Name: The Northeast Corner of the Tavern
Rooms.Description:
Along this east wall of the tavern are all the tables for the meals.
Outside the windows you see cobblestone streets.

Rooms.Name: The West Wall of the Tavern
Rooms.Description:
The band has set up here, against the west wall. Many people dance
to the music.

Rooms.Name: The East Wall of the Tavern
Rooms.Description:
The tables are set up here, and you see many couples and group just
sitting and talking. They have drinks on their tables and smiles on
their faces.

Rooms.Name: The Southwest Corner of the Tavern
Rooms.Description:
There are many people here, but there seems to be a slight stench
coming from somewhere.

Rooms.Name: The South Wall of the Tavern
Rooms.Description:
The South Wall windows overlook the sea. There seems to be an island
far to the south, and boats just floating in the ports. The party-goers
wander around here.

Rooms.Name: The Southeast Corner of the Tavern
Rooms.Description:
There are tables here that continue to the north. The party-goers
just mingle and hit on each other.

Rooms.Name: Cellar
Rooms.Description:
The stairway seems to lead down into the cellar. It stinks of wine,
beer and snakes here.

Rooms.Name: Cellar
Rooms.Description:
There are huge wine casks against this wall. Most seem intact though
one is eaten through, and the inside seems to have a gooey green
substance.

Exits.Description: There is the sound of singing in that corner.
There is a shimmering light to the south.

Rooms.Name: Cellar
Rooms.Description:
There is a chair in corner, and plenty of empty bottles. There is
also the evidence of that green substance here as well.

Rooms.Name: Cellar
Rooms.Description:
There is a slime trail here. There seems to be much broken glass
down here.

Rooms.Name: The Britain Moongate
Rooms.Description:
The place around the moongate, as always, seems clean and neat. The
blue light of the moongate has become a comforting sight to you.

Rooms.Name: Cellar
Rooms.Description:
The walls are leaking here. You can hear the bang of feet and the
shifting of chairs from above.

Rooms.Name: Cellar
Rooms.Description:
The damp walls of this corner bother you... Not because it's damp -
because it's not water!

Rooms.Name: Cellar
Rooms.Description: The smells and ventilation of this cellar are overpowering.

Exits.Description: There is a shimmering light.

Rooms.Name: Cellar
Rooms.Description:
This corner of the cellar is the ugliest. From the smell in the corner
it is obvious where the Drunks clear their guts.

Rooms.Name: The Yew Entrance
Rooms.Description:
To the south you see a large courthouse and a small part of Yew. Most
of Yew is secretly hidden in the branches of the forest. To the north you
see one of the most dangerous parts of this same forest.

Rooms.Name: In Front of the Courthouse
Rooms.Description:
The immense Courthouse faces this street. All of Britannia's crime goes
here to be tried. There is little crime anymore though, after the great
enlightenment. There is also a pub to the west.

Exits.Description: The courthouse doors lie this way.

Rooms.Name: Justice Row
Rooms.Description:
The cobblestone road leads into a clearing of the woods to the east and
to a pub to the west. To your south you see a great Courthouse, but its
entrance is on the east.

Rooms.Name: Under the Stone Arch
Rooms.Description:
You stand under a large stone arch. To your east there is a bonfire.
Around the bonfire are these same stone arches; they form a circle around
the clearing.

Exits.Description: There are chanting druids and a large bonfire to the east.

Rooms.Name: Bonfire
Rooms.Description:
The heat from the bonfire warms you even at the fringe of the ceremony.
Here, Druids form a circle and chant the sacred mantra.

Rooms.Name: Pub
Rooms.Description:
You are in a happy little pub. There are many little tables and
citizens are talking here.

Rooms.Name: Justice Row
Rooms.Description: There are some citizens strolling on the road. There is a Pub to the west.

Rooms.Name: Justice Row
Rooms.Description:
Perhaps the only real street in a city where all the citizens are
nestled in trees, it leads east to west.

Rooms.Name: The Audience Room
Rooms.Description:
This is where people would sit to see the cases and wait for the Judge.
To the North you see the actual Bench. All around are the pew-like seats.

Rooms.Name: The Bench
Rooms.Description:
The Bench is one of the most imposing things you've seen. You have to
crane your neck to even glimpse at the Judge. There are no lawyers, there
is only justice. To the east and west there are the prisons.

Rooms.Name: Prison
Rooms.Description:
To the north you see a cell. Locks are unnecessary, because the
prisoners are kept in their cells by magic.

Exits.Description: The prisoner looks at you and growls.

Rooms.Name: Prison
Rooms.Description:
To the north you see a cell. Locks are unnecessary, because the
prisoners are kept in their cells by magic.

Exits.Description: The prisoner is a small man.

Rooms.Name: Prison Cell
Rooms.Description: This is a cell where they keep dangerous prisoners.

Rooms.Name: Prison Cell
Rooms.Description: This is a cell where they keep dangerous prisoners.

Rooms.Name: Yew Forest
Rooms.Description:
The Yew Forest stretches out in every direction. Gnarled yew
trees stand all around, branches reaching down to snag you as you
pass. The ground is mostly bare and the trees all look the same.
The Druids can find their way through the forest, wonder how
they do it? An arrow carved into a nearby tree points south.

Exits.Description: A trail winds its way between the trees.
A trail winds its way between the trees.
A trail winds its way between the trees.
A trail winds its way between the trees.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
It is well known that druids will not deface the sacred trees, so
this is most likely a hoax. There are some trail markings near the
eastern path.

Rooms.Name: The Yew Moongate
Rooms.Description:
All of a sudden it seems, the trees part and you find yourself before
a blue glowing moongate. It hums with energy, waiting to take you to new
worlds - but only if you have the key! Paths lead off in all directions
through the woods.

Exits.Description: A trail winds its way between the trees.
A trail winds its way between the trees.
A trail winds its way between the trees.

Rooms.Name: Dungeon Entrance
Rooms.Description:
There is a huge maw of an entrance to one of the terrible Dungeons.
After the Age of Enlightenment only 8 sources of evil still survive in the
world.  These are the eight Dungeons. Now they are being cleaned out.

Exits.Description: A cold draft pours out of the dungeon.

Rooms.Name: The Dungeon
Rooms.Description:
These dungeon rooms all seem the same. There are signs of recent battles
everywhere.

Mobs.Name: insects swarm bugs
Mobs.LongDescription: You hear buzzing, and see a swarm of insects flying at you.
Mobs.Description:
These insects are more of an annoyance than a threat.
It is made up of hundreds of annoying insects.

Mobs.Name: bat
Mobs.LongDescription: A black furry bat flies into your face.
Mobs.Description:
You hear a high pitch screech. It is a black furry bat. This
annoying creature usually travel in flocks, so WATCH OUT.

Mobs.Name: shepherd man
Mobs.LongDescription: A humble shepherd is here looking after his sheep.
Mobs.Description:
The shepherd is a a patient old man, who has spent all his days looking after
his sheep, and all his nights studying the virtue of Humility. Through the his
wrinkled face though you can see his proud dignity and begin to sense that he
was once a warrior.

Mobs.Name: girl child
Mobs.LongDescription: A smiling young girl is here.
Mobs.Description:
The girl looks shyly at you. Even at this
young age, she has learned enough of her
culture to be humble. She jumps rope and
look up at you expectantly.

Mobs.Name: sheep
Mobs.LongDescription: A sheep peacefully eats grass.
Mobs.Description:
Even the sheep in New Magincia seem to exude
humbleness. The sheep has pure white fleece.

Mobs.Name: katrina woman shepherd
Mobs.LongDescription: Katrina the Shepherd is her looking over the village.
Mobs.Description:
Katrina was one of the Warriors of Destiny. She epitomizes the virtue of
humility. After her great Enlightenment, she traveled back to her home and
helped rebuild Magincia. She still is a great warrior and an able guardian
of New Magincia.

Mobs.Name: rat
Mobs.LongDescription: A rat is gnawing on a book.
Mobs.Description:
This giant rat is smelly and fleas jump up from fur. The rats
have been a great problem in the library because they eat and
shred the books. This rat seems to be rabid, so beware of his
teeth.

Mobs.Name: spider
Mobs.LongDescription: The giant spider sits on its web.
Mobs.Description:
This scavenger has seemed to collected many things,
including books, scrolls, and other scraps. His
glistening teeth drip with poison.

Mobs.Name: mage
Mobs.LongDescription: A mage stands here reading a book.
Mobs.Description:
The mage in his ever-increasing search for Honesty
and Truth, has come to library to peruse the ancient
tomes of knowledge. He glances at you, and returns
to his study.

Mobs.Name: nystul librarian mage
Mobs.LongDescription: Nystul the Librarian sits at his desk, writing some scrolls.
Mobs.Description:
Nystul is the mentor, teacher, mage of the Lyceum.
He is a shining example of Truth. His head is bowed
over a book, but power radiates from him.

Mobs.Name: mariah mage
Mobs.LongDescription: Mariah walks around the stacks, busily looking for a book.
Mobs.Description:
Mariah is another Warrior of Destiny. She joined
the Avatar to add some magical punch during his
Enlightenment. She seems serene in her total
devotion to the virtue of Honesty.
Mobs.ActionScript: %10 say Where is that damn book!

Mobs.Name: slime puddle mass
Mobs.LongDescription: An ugly green mass sits on the ground in a puddle.
Mobs.Description:
The slime is an amorphous goo. It seems pretty
wimpy, but it has alot of friends. As you look
at it you wonder who these things reproduce.

Mobs.Name: snake
Mobs.LongDescription: The snake strikes.
Mobs.Description:
The green snake tongue darts in and out tasting the air.
It sense spilled beer, and the distinctive taste of human.

Mobs.Name: horse smithy
Mobs.LongDescription: Mr. Smithy, the talking horse, is chewing hay.
Mobs.Description:
This useless horse is a novelty, he can talk. Though
his talk is often meaningless and he gives out irrelevant
clues, his sleek body and his much practiced jaw muscles
can be very dangerous.

Mobs.Name: bard musician
Mobs.LongDescription: A bard sits here strumming his mandolin.
Mobs.Description:
The bard seems happy and content to play his
mandolin. He is a seeker of compassion, but
in the his spare time he sings and dances.

Mobs.Name: beggar
Mobs.LongDescription: A beggar is here with his hand out.
Mobs.Description:
He is more accustomed to receiving Compassion,
than giving it. But help him out gov, give him
a few coins.
Mobs.ActionScript: %10 emote begs you for a dime or two -- or twenty!

Mobs.Name: iolo bard musician
Mobs.LongDescription: Iolo sits here with a bottle in his hand, and a smile on his face.
Mobs.Description:
Iolo is one of the first Warrior of Destiny. He seems to be a little
bit tipsy from the party and you wonder why he has wandered down to
the cellar. Anyway, in the spirit of the virtue Compassion that he
embodies, he holds out a bottle for you.
Mobs.ActionScript: %20 dizzy;%10 say hmm you twins or something?

Mobs.Name: townsman man
Mobs.LongDescription: A townsman is here downing drinks.
Mobs.Description:
This townsman is here partying and having many drinks. Though
he is also an ardent believer in Compassion, and a responsible
citizen, he knows the value of a good party.

Mobs.Name: gwenno bard
Mobs.LongDescription: Gwenno the Bard, Iolo's happy wife, wanders around with bow in hand.
Mobs.Description:
You see a pretty woman, with finely sculptured musculature. She's seems
to guard the party with her Infinity Bow, the best bow in the Ultima world.
Her kindly eyes seem to emit pure Compassion, and as she wanders she helps
the drunks up and leads them out the door.
Mobs.ActionScript: %10 sing;%10 say Hi folks, you seen the avatar?

Mobs.Name: orc ape
Mobs.LongDescription: A mutated ape carries a spear.
Mobs.Description:
This orc is a disgusting animal, this ape-like monster
scratches it armpits. It travels in herds and is a coward.

Mobs.Name: troll
Mobs.LongDescription: A stony troll swings his club.
Mobs.Description:
This huge monster is immense and powerful. Over a chest and a
head taller then you, his meaty arms swings a club at you.

Mobs.Name: druid
Mobs.LongDescription: A chanting druid walks the woods.
Mobs.Description:
Dressed in long robes that obscure his face, the druid is softly chanting
words and traveling through the woods. He is one that is secure in his
sense of Justice, and enlightened in the ways of judging others. Through
his communion with nature, he has gained power.

Mobs.Name: druid
Mobs.LongDescription: A druid walks around a flame.
Mobs.Description:
This druid seems to be entranced by the fire. She chants
softly as she waves her hand and stares into the flame.
She is one with the flame. When she looks at you her hard
eyes, only judge, seeking Justice.

Mobs.Name: judge
Mobs.LongDescription: The judge sits here.
Mobs.Description:
You cannot help but shiver as you see the Judge sit here silently.
His eyes pierce into your soul, and he knows. He knows your faults.
He knows your virtues. He knows if you've been bad or good....so be
good. This ultimate purveyor of Justice, sends criminals to jail
everyday, sometimes with his bare hands.

Mobs.Name: jaana druid
Mobs.LongDescription: Jaana the Druid is in deep meditation.
Mobs.Description:
You meet the another Warrior of Destiny. She helped to lead the
magical force to the Avatar. The Avatar's mentor in Justice, she
has gone to the woods to drive life into a corner.

Mobs.Name: prisoner
Mobs.LongDescription: The Prisoner grips the bars with his dirty hands.
Mobs.Description:
The Prisoner seems to a be slimy character. He was a thief,
and Justice was done to him. You glimpse light shining off
of something black in his hands.

Mobs.Name: prisoner
Mobs.LongDescription: The Prisoner is big and grins evilly at you.
Mobs.Description:
This Prisoner was convicted of one of the most
heinous crimes, MURDER. It took many guards and
druids to restrain this beast.

Mobs.Name: citizen yewsman
Mobs.LongDescription: A citizen of Yew walks around.
Mobs.Description:
Being the second largest city in Britannia, second
only to Britain itself, this city employs and houses
many people. This citizen of the city of Justice
strolls the street, sure of his Virtue.

Mobs.Name: bartender
Mobs.LongDescription: A bartender stands here in middle of a throng of people.
Mobs.Description:
A smiling face asks you want you would like to drink.
Well versed in compassion, he has heard and sympathized
with many people how have gone to him for advice. His
advice to you, is to kick back and enjoy a drink.

Mobs.Name: owner bartender
Mobs.LongDescription: The owner of the pub walks around to her customers.
Mobs.Description:
The pub owner waves and smiles to you. She
asks what you want to drink and eat.

Mobs.Name: ettin
Mobs.LongDescription: The ettin scratches its heads, and attacks.
Mobs.Description:
With its two heads, it should make sense that this monster should
have double the intelligence. But in fact it has half.

Mobs.Name: gremlin
Mobs.LongDescription: This little creature sneaks around and steals your food.
Mobs.Description:
He seems to be just a head with little hands and feet sticking
out of it. It does not seem like these things could hurt you,
but your money pouch seems much lighter.

Mobs.Name: headless
Mobs.LongDescription: The headless creature seems to be heading right for you!
Mobs.Description:
No one really understands how these things can sense,
but as it unerringly reaches for you, you know it does.
In any case these creatures are strong and endurable.

Mobs.Name: fighter
Mobs.LongDescription: A muscular fighter searches here.
Mobs.Description:
This fighter is cleaning out the dungeons. In the
peaceful time following the Avatar's success, there
are few ways to show Valour.

Mobs.Name: geoffrey fighter
Mobs.LongDescription: Geoffrey the Fighter leads this campaign.
Mobs.Description:
The muscle power of the Warriors of Destiny, Geoffrey is
immense. His board shoulders make you look like a mouse.
He epitomizes Valour.

Mobs.Name: lord serpent simon
Mobs.LongDescription: Lord Simon of the Serpent Hold stares at your form.
Mobs.Description:
His movements are liquid and art. As he makes a few practice
swings, you HOPE that you are never on the receiving end of his
immense sword. This is The Lord of Serpent Hold, courage itself
solidified into a human form.

Objects.Name: mantra compassion mu key
Objects.Description: Mu, the Mantra of Compassion is here.

Objects.Name: mantra justice beh key
Objects.Description: Beh, the Mantra of Justice is here.

Objects.Name: mantra honesty ahm key
Objects.Description: ahm, the Mantra of Honesty is here.

Objects.Name: mantra valour ra key
Objects.Description: Ra, the Mantra of Valour is here.

Objects.Name: moonstone key
Objects.Description: A totally featureless moonstone is here.

Objects.Name: moonstone key
Objects.Description: A totally featureless moonstone is here.

Objects.Name: moonstone key
Objects.Description: A totally featureless moonstone is here.

Objects.Name: moonstone key
Objects.Description: A totally featureless moonstone is here.

Objects.Name: moonstone key
Objects.Description: A totally featureless moonstone is here.

Objects.Name: crook
Objects.Description: The crook lies here.

Objects.Name: doll
Objects.Description: An old rag doll is here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The rag doll seems to take on the weight of the child you killed.

Objects.Name: sword katrina
Objects.Description: Katrina's sword gleams prettily.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The sword is shined and cared for with much care. It glows with
the light of virtue.

Objects.Name: scroll
Objects.Description: A scroll rescued from the spider's web.

Objects.Name: dagger
Objects.Description: The magic dagger lies here, pulsating.

Objects.Name: robe
Objects.Description: The robes of a mage lies here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: These robes are comfortable and clean.

Objects.Name: horseshoes
Objects.Description: Smithy's horseshoes are here.

Objects.Name: mandolin instrument
Objects.Description: The fine instrument lies here.

Objects.Name: cup
Objects.Description: The beggar's cup is here.

Objects.Name: gold
Objects.Description: Gold pieces.

Objects.Name: bottle
Objects.Description: Iolo's bottle sits here.

Objects.Name: mandolin silver
Objects.Description: Iolo's mandolin stands against a wall.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Crafted by the master himself, Iolo, the mandolin is finely made. Its
wood gleams, and as you pluck the string the clearest note sounds.

Objects.Name: mandolin golden
Objects.Description: The golden mandolin floats here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The bow is immense, yet light. You see no string, but as your
hands touch the bow a string of pure energy appears and the bow
vibrates with power.

Objects.Name: spear
Objects.Description: A simple wooden spear lies here.

Objects.Name: club
Objects.Description: A stone club is here.

Objects.Name: gavel
Objects.Description: The Judge's gavel lies here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The Gavel is made of ironwood, and seems to have some of the
qualities of Justice in it.

Objects.Name: quarterstaff
Objects.Description: Jaana's staff lies here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Jaana's staff is strangely shaped, in a double helix form. As
you look at the two snake-like pieces of wood, they seems to
move.

Objects.Name: sword geoffrey
Objects.Description: Geoffrey's sword gleams in the sun.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Geoffrey's sword is heavy but sharp. When you touch the jeweled
hilt, power floods into your arm.

Objects.Name: sword
Objects.Description: A simple sword is here.

Objects.Name: sword bastard
Objects.Description: Simon's monstrous bastard sword lies here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This is the biggest and best sword you've ever seen. It's 
balance is perfect and it is sharp and sure. When you grab 
it, you suddenly feel incredibly strong, and incredibly 
courageous.
